senses.gloss:
a. 
__1 Uneaten, unenjoyed, unused; अभुक्तायां यस्यां क्षणमपि न यातं नृपशतैः [[Bh. 3. 25.]] 
__2 (Actively used) One who has not eaten, enjoyed, used &c.; cf. पीत. 
-Comp. 
-मूलम् the interval between the closing part of Jyeṣṭhā and the beginging of Mūla.

a. Ved. 
__1 One who has not experienced or enjoyed न म आशृणोः किमभुग्वदासि [[Rv. 10. 95. 11.]] 
__2 one who does not keep a promise.

a. 
__1 Not eating. 
__2 Not allowing to enjoy, stingy; अध स्वप्नस्य निर्विदेऽभुञ्जतश्च रेवतः [[Rv. 1. 120. 12.]] 
__3 Not protecting.

a. 
__1 Not bent or crooked, straight, 
__2 Well, free from disease.
a. A little curved or bent.
Not a slave or servant, an independent woman; एष स जन एतामिच्छत्यभुजिष्यां कर्तुम् [[Mk. 4.]]

a. Non-existent, what is not or has not been; not true or real, false; स्तुवन्ति श्रान्तास्याः क्षितिपतिमभूतैरपि गुणैः [[Mu. 3. 16]], [[Ki. 14. 19]]; [[Rām. 5. 14. 34.]] 
-Comp. 
-आहरणम् 'utterance of an unreality', a covert expression, a speech founded on fraud, one of the members of garbha [[S. D. 365.]] 
-तद्भावः the becoming or being changed into, or making, that which it is not before; कृभ्वस्तियोगे संपद्येकर्तरि च्विः [[P. V. 4. 50]]; अभूततद्भावे इति वक्तव्यम्; अकृष्णः कृष्णः संपद्यते तं करोति कृष्णीकरोति [[Sk.]]; cf. पयोधरीभूतचतुःसमुद्राम् [[R. 2. 3.]] 
-पूर्व a. unprecedented, unsurpassed; अभूत् °र्वो राजा चिन्तामणिर्नाम [[Vās. 1]], कुतोऽद्यसमरोदधेरयमभूतपूर्वः पुरः [[Ve. 3. 2.]] [[Śi. 3. 3.]] 
-प्रादुर्भावः becoming manifest of what has not been before. 
-शत्रु a. having no enemy.

f. 
__1 Non-existence, non-entity. 
__2 Want of power. 
__3 Poverty. 
__4 Destruction; कालोऽयं दारुणः प्राप्तो भरतानामभूतये [[Mb. 3. 29. 50.]]

f. 
__1 Pervasion. 
__2 Overpowering strength; आभूत्या सहजा वज्रसायक [[Rv. 10. 84. 6.]] 
__3 Capability, efficiency. 
__4 Production; आभूतिरेषाभूतिर्बीजमेतन्निधीयते [[Ait. Br. 8. 13. 8.]]

f. 
__1 Non-earth, anything but earth, 
__2 An unfit place or object, no proper object for, beyond the reach or scope of; अभूमिरियं मालविकायाः [[M. 3]]; अभूमिरियमविनयस्य [[Ś. 7]]; स खलु मनोरथानामप्यभूमिर्विसर्जनावसरसत्कारः ibid. far exceeded or transcended my (highest) expectations; [[Śi. 1. 42]]; [[Śānti. 4. 22.]] [[K. 45]], 196, 204. 
-Comp. 
-ज 
__1 produced in a bad or improper place. 
__2 not produced in earth.
a. few, some; several; so, अभूमन्, अभूयिष्ठ.
a. [आ-भू-डु] Pervading, reaching; तुच्छ्येनाभ्वपिहितं यदासीत् [[Rv. 10. 129. 3.]] ([[Sāy.]]); empty; stingy, empty-handed; सत्यध्वृतं वृजिनायन्तमाभुम् [[Rv. 10. 27. 1.]]
€1P. Ved. To be present, continue one's existence; यद्यद्भवन्ति तदाभवन्ति [[Ch. Up. 6. 9. 3.]]

a. Ved. Approaching (as a praiser); इन्द्रः श्नथयन्ननाभुबः [[Rv. 1. 51. 9.]] 
__2 Strong, sufficient, efficacious. 
__3 Applied according to rule (as a hymn).
